78883.subject: World's Launch Theater
78883.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

GM and happy Thursday!

Hunter Biden picked yesterday to launch a memecoin named after the laptop, and traders ran it to a twelve-figure FDV and back inside two hours. 

We break down the launch below, then dig into [World.xyz](https://World.xyz) opening its standalone prediction market platform to a claimed 1M-person waitlist.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

Hunter Biden's LAPTOP hit Base on schedule Wednesday morning and produced the fastest round trip of the year. Snipers and click traders [pushed](https://x.com/DegenerateNews/status/2097663789852238177) the token's FDV past $110B in the first hour on about $7M of pool liquidity before the price collapsed >99% within two hours of launch, sitting at a $823M FDV this morning. Biden [pitched](https://x.com/HunterBiden/status/2097448481808080911) the launch as redemption economics, saying 20% of supply goes to an airdrop that includes wallets that lost money on TRUMP, while 30% sits behind burn-or-charity milestone triggers. 

The airdrop fed the dump: subscribers to Biden's Substack could claim 4,276 tokens each, and traders tracking the claims counted $1.8M claimed and sold within hours of launch. Biden [responded](https://x.com/HunterBiden/status/2097790749861638547) Wednesday evening, blaming thin liquidity and predatory snipers while claiming the team's allocation stayed locked and nobody on his side sold. 

A Community Note attached to the post counters that a project multisig received 100M tokens, 10% of supply, before launch and has sold about 42.5M of them, citing onchain data reported by Quartz and CoinDesk. Matt Casto of CMT Digital called the setup "[a terrible snipe environment](https://x.com/mcasto_/status/2097670755840413702)" as trading opened, pointing to hundreds of decoy LAPTOP pairs and a contract address everyone already knew.
